seo.fluege.title: Cheap flights compared
seo.fluege.description: Live flight prices from multiple sources – cheapest first, no sign-up.
seo.fluege.intro: We query several flight sources at once and show the cheapest price first. The final price including baggage is only shown when the source provides it.
seo.hotels.title: Hotels compared
seo.hotels.description: Hotel prices from multiple sources – per night and room, transparent, no sign-up.
seo.hotels.intro: Hotel prices are provided per night or per stay depending on the source. We state the price basis for every offer; taxes and fees only when the source names them.
seo.faehren.title: Ferries compared
seo.faehren.description: Ferry prices from multiple sources – per person, transparent, no sign-up.
seo.faehren.intro: Ferry prices differ by basis: seat per person or cabin. We state the price basis for every offer. Vehicle fares are not supported at present.
seo.kreuzfahrten.title: Cruises compared
seo.kreuzfahrten.description: Cruise prices from multiple sources – per person, transparent, no sign-up.
seo.kreuzfahrten.intro: Cruise prices apply per person for the whole trip. Whether taxes and fees are included differs by source – we state it for every offer.
